meta.name: ALD Ontology
meta.scope: Broad top-level ALD skeleton; deep on HAR-conformality core. v0.2 audited against Cremers 2019 (conformality) + Kessels 2025 (ALD primer).

classes.definition: Root of the ALD domain taxonomy.
One run at a unique combination of controlled conditions. A profile plot (thickness vs depth) is ONE experiment; a condition sweep (GPC vs temperature) is one experiment PER point.
A group of experiments from one figure/table that sweep a single condition (the per-point case).
A figure/panel an experiment was extracted from.
A kind of measurable quantity (temperature, GPC, ...). Quantities are instances of this.
A concrete value of a QuantityKind within one experiment (carries the role: independent/controlled/dependent).
Organic/inorganic hybrid film (molecular layer deposition; alucone, zincone).
A chemical species involved in the ALD process.
Oxygen source (H2O, O3, O2 plasma, H2O2).
Reductant for metal ALD (H2, B2H6, borane).
Growth surface / substrate material and termination.
Chemical termination of the growth surface (-OH, -H, ...).
Reaction zones separated in space, not time.
Gas transport regime set by Knudsen number.
Feature geometry where deposition/conformality is studied.
Lateral high-aspect-ratio channel (e.g. PillarHall test chip).
Anodized aluminium oxide, parallel cylindrical pores.
Evolution of GPC with cycle count.
Self-limited process family beyond film ALD.
Dominant physical regime; routes an experiment to a model family.
PEALD radical loss by surface recombination limits penetration.
A predictive/mechanistic model. Deep model-aware layer (equations, assumptions, priors, validity) is deferred to v2; taxonomy seeded here.
A key modelling assumption (v2 attaches validity).
Application domain / target use of an ALD film.

relations.definition: e.g. damkohler_number couples reaction and transport quantities.
a model applies to / simulates a process regime (was governed_by, direction fixed).
the independent axis this experiment sweeps (a coordinate, for a profile-type experiment).
the CONDITION a per-point experiment series sweeps (temperature, pulse_time, ...).
structure size + pressure set the transport regime.
